messages:
Rina C: quick poll — who here accidentally released a `major` because of a misplaced colon? :raised_hands:
Sam B: once. i renamed a key from `timeout_ms` to `timeout:ms` and babel/ci treated it like a betrayal. bump to 1.0.0-therapy.
Harpreet: haha semantic versioning should have an emotional severity field. like 2.3.0+trauma.
Maya: i'm creating a PR template that asks: 'Did you check YAML spacing, semver feelings, and your therapist?' :laughing:
Rina C: also saw `parser.go` throw "unexpected : in key" which feels personal. attached stack snippet:
Rina C: ```
panic: invalid character ':' in map key
  at github.com/redwood/config.parse (/src/config/parser.go:123)
```
deploy-bot: [SYSTEM] Deployment started: release v2.4.1 -> staging
Sam B: i demand a linter that comments on PRs with comforting messages. like "This is okay, we will fix it together."
Harpreet: i'll add a `yaml-therapy` GH action. if it fails it posts a gif of a kitten. mandatory comfort. :cat2:
Maya: we should also make our semver policy stricter: no major bumps for punctuation crimes.
Rina C: agreed. converting this thread into a docs ticket: "semver etiquette + YAML hygiene"
Sam B: meme caption: "compiler: 'I have no idea what's wrong' runtime: 'i've been keeping secrets.'"
Harpreet: vote: tabs or spaces? (this is not a trick)
Maya: spaces. 2. always.
Sam B: spaces. 4 for life.
Rina C: spaces. 2. also add `yq` to pre-commit.
deploy-bot: [SYSTEM] Deployment succeeded: release v2.4.1 -> staging (all checks passed)
Maya: resolution: kitten gifs + pre-commit linters. semver trauma counseling next week. :raised_hands:
